bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears are facing the Detroit Lions in their traditional Thanksgiving Day showdown, with the game in progress as Chicago's offense battles to close the gap, cutting the deficit through scoring drives including a Kyle Monangai touchdown and a Cairo Santos field goal. Chicago enters the contest 8-2 after a 21-13 win over the Saints , but is dealing with notable injury concerns as Kyler Gordon is out and Tyrique Stevenson is listed as questionable for the pivotal NFC North matchup.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are facing the Chicago Bears live on Thanksgiving Day in a key Week 12 NFC North showdown, with Jared Goff throwing his 21st touchdown pass of the season to LaPorta to boost the Lions' lead late in the first half , while Jahmyr Gibbs also scored his 16th touchdown of 2026, marking his first career score on Thanksgiving Day . Off the field, the team is dealing with roster turmoil after rookie DT Skyler Gill-Howard was lost for the 2026 season to a season-ending knee injury , prompting Detroit to place a DT on IR and elevate a defensive end ahead of the Bears matchup .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers dropped their Thanksgiving Eve matchup to the Los Angeles Rams, falling to 6-4 and remaining in last place in the NFC North. Green Bay drops to 6-4, stays in last place in NFC North , while Micah Parsons made his long-awaited return from injury but reportedly called out teammates afterward, as Micah Parsons calls out Packers teammates: "Who's going to be a dog or not" following the disappointing defeat.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest Vikings-related story in the last 24 hours involves the Aaron Rodgers saga and its ripple effects: the Pittsburgh Steelers officially released quarterback Aaron Rodgers on Wednesday after he publicly criticized head coach Mike McCarthy, and Minnesota is reportedly among the favorites to pursue him off waivers. Shortly after his criticism, the Steelers announced that they had released the quarterback, and he officially hit the waiver wire Wednesday afternoon, ending Rodgers' hopes of a reunion with McCarthy in Pittsburgh.
